cohort: The study included 252,542 women who delivered by spontaneous vaginal delivery or instrumental delivery beyond 24 weeks gestation at a single tertiary medical center between 1988 and 2016.
finding: Epidural analgesia was found to be an independent risk factor for OASIS, even after controlling for various confounding factors.
mod_finding: Women with OASIS had higher rates of vacuum extraction delivery, although epidural analgesia remained an independent risk factor after controlling for vacuum delivery.
